prompt: One finished landscape 3:2 close educational diagram of oxygen moving from ONE lung air sac into blood. Show a single rounded pale air-sac cavity in upper center, with a short separate gray airway opening at its top. Along the sac's lower curved edge is ONE thin intact shared gas-exchange boundary beside a red capillary vessel. The capillary enters from LEFT dark-burgundy red, curves along the sac, exits RIGHT brighter red; small arrows INSIDE the blood vessel point left-to-right. Keep the complete diagram within the central 70 percent of the canvas, generous cream margin all around. Friendly crisp 2D dark outlines, flat colors, no texture or gore. The supplied reference is organ-color/style context only, not the composition.
